query:
SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_access_grants g
                            WHERE g.subject_table = $2 AND g.subject_id = $3
                              AND g.principal_table = 'kb_profiles' AND g.principal_id = $1
                              AND g.can_grant)
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_access_grants g
                                JOIN kb_teams t ON t.id = g.principal_id
                                               AND t.personal_of = $1 AND t.is_active
                               WHERE g.subject_table = $2 AND g.subject_id = $3
                                 AND g.principal_table = 'kb_teams'
                                 AND g.can_grant)
                   OR derived_access_profile($1, 'grant', $2, $3)) AS "e!: bool"
